$measurement_comment: This artifact records the DECLARATION only. No verdict, no commit identity and no working-tree observation is persisted (RFP-2, RFP-3): the gate's finding lives in its exit code.

artifact_classes.convergence: INVARIANT — authored; no producer rewrites it, so it is trivially a fixed point.
artifact_classes.definition: A version-controlled, human-authored corpus file of an included type. The only registrable class.
artifact_classes.name: Canonical Source

artifact_classes.convergence: REQUIRED — must be byte-reproducible from canonical source by its owner.
artifact_classes.definition: A deterministically re-derivable projection of the registered corpus: the emitted registries, DATA, control tower and portal. Regenerated, never hand-registered; the register must not list itself.
artifact_classes.name: Generated Projection

artifact_classes.convergence: REQUIRED — a programme determination is evidence, and evidence that re-execution does not reproduce is Evidence Drift.
artifact_classes.definition: Execution and coordination state: programme lanes, determinations, dashboards and registers of the Master Context System. Knowledge state is corpus; execution state is memory; the two are never mixed.
artifact_classes.name: Operational Memory

artifact_classes.convergence: REQUIRED — derived truth must be re-derivable, or it is not truth.
artifact_classes.definition: Repository-derived intelligence emitted by a located producer outside the projection zone, declaring AUTHORITY = NONE. Derived state is neither knowledge state nor execution state, and is never authoritative.
artifact_classes.name: Derived Intelligence

artifact_classes.convergence: REQUIRED-WHEN-TRACKED — per-run evidence is not tracked; where a family is tracked it carries the full obligation.
artifact_classes.definition: Per-run execution evidence and audit trails produced by a gate or engine as proof of a specific execution.
artifact_classes.name: Evidence

artifact_classes.convergence: REQUIRED — a certification whose re-execution differs certifies nothing.
artifact_classes.definition: The verdict artifacts of a certification runtime: certification registers, gate registers and seals.
artifact_classes.name: Certification

artifact_classes.convergence: EXEMPT — never tracked, so outside the fixed point by construction.
artifact_classes.definition: Build, cache, dependency, coverage, lock and editor outputs. Environment artifacts.
artifact_classes.name: Transient Output

class_derivation.$comment: Totality without enumeration. Any present or future family is placed by these ordered questions; no family needs a new class and no path is listed.
class_derivation.invariant: Exactly one class admits registration (CLS-CANONICAL-SOURCE). Every class that is tracked and has a producer carries the convergence obligation. There is no class that is both derived and registrable — which is the state that produced CK-REG-DRIFT.
ordered_questions: Is it absent from version control (ignored or untracked)? → CLS-TRANSIENT if environment output, else CLS-EVIDENCE.
Does a located producer rewrite it? → NO: CLS-CANONICAL-SOURCE.
Is it emitted into the corpus-internal projection zone? → CLS-GENERATED-PROJECTION.
Is it a verdict of a certification runtime? → CLS-CERTIFICATION.
Is it programme execution or coordination state? → CLS-OPERATIONAL-MEMORY.
Otherwise it is producer output declaring AUTHORITY = NONE → CLS-DERIVED-INTELLIGENCE.

closure_criteria.criterion: the tree is clean before the fixed point is asserted
closure_criteria.note: a fixed point cannot be asserted over an uncommitted tree; this fails closed rather than measuring the wrong state

closure_criteria.criterion: every required pipeline stage exits successfully
no tracked file is modified by any pass
no file is staged by any pass
no untracked entry appears outside a constitutionally excluded location
the repository is byte-identical after every declared pass
all residue is attributable to a declared producer
every discovered producer is a declared pipeline stage
every path a producer writes lies inside a declared write zone
declared write zones are pairwise disjoint, so ownership is exactly one
no discovered producer candidate is left unprobed
no stage writes into another stage's declared write zone

cycle_classes.name: Self-observation cycle
cycle_classes.remediation: Stop persisting the observation. Keep it as an input to the gate verdict and to standard output.
cycle_classes.signature: The producer's output differs between two consecutive executions at ONE unchanged commit. Only an input the producer itself perturbs can do that; the working tree is the input it perturbs by writing.

cycle_classes.name: Commit-identity cycle
cycle_classes.remediation: Remove the commit identity from the emitted bytes. Version control already records it.
cycle_classes.signature: The bytes a producer writes contain a hex token that this repository's object database resolves to a commit. Only `git rev-parse`-class input produces that, and the artifact is inside a commit it cannot name.

cycle_classes.name: Hash cycle
cycle_classes.remediation: Break the mutual embedding: one side must derive from the other, never both.
cycle_classes.signature: Within one pipeline pass, artifact A's written bytes contain the content hash of artifact B while B's written bytes contain the content hash of A.

cycle_classes.name: Registration cycle
cycle_classes.remediation: Withdraw the class from registration through the declared admission authority.
cycle_classes.signature: A producer that does not own the registration projections nevertheless causes them to change — so a non-canonical artifact is carrying a registered identity.

cycle_classes.name: Recursive generator
cycle_classes.remediation: Declare the stage non-reentrant; the aggregate must exclude itself from its own pipeline.
cycle_classes.signature: A producer re-enters itself, directly or through an aggregate that invokes it.

cycle_classes.name: Undeclared producer
cycle_classes.remediation: Declare the producer as a pipeline stage, or stop it from writing tracked content.
cycle_classes.signature: Tracked content changed during a pipeline pass but no declared stage's write zone contains it.

cycle_classes.name: Undiscovered producer
cycle_classes.remediation: Declare the producer as a pipeline stage with its write zone, positioned after the stages whose output it consumes; or stop it writing tracked content.
cycle_classes.signature: An executable named by the repository's own Execution Surface writes tracked content when executed, yet is not a stage of the declared pipeline. The proof is behavioural: the candidate was run in isolation and its writes were measured, so the finding never rests on where the file lives or what it is called.

cycle_classes.name: Producer outside write governance
cycle_classes.remediation: Extend the owning stage's declared write zone to cover the path, or move the output inside the zone its producer already owns.
cycle_classes.signature: A path a producer was OBSERVED to write lies inside no declared write zone. The artifact therefore has no constitutional owner and no pipeline coverage, whether or not the producer that wrote it is declared.

cycle_classes.name: Ambiguous write scope
cycle_classes.remediation: Make the declared write zones pairwise disjoint: narrow the broader zone, or merge the stages that genuinely share an output surface.
cycle_classes.signature: Two stages declare write zones where one is a prefix of the other, so a path inside the overlap belongs to more than one write scope and 'exactly one owner' is not well-defined. Attribution would then depend on the order zones happen to be read.

cycle_classes.name: Unprobed producer candidate
cycle_classes.remediation: Make the candidate runnable from a clean checkout, declare it as a stage so the pipeline runs it, or give it the inputs its earlier stages owe it.
cycle_classes.signature: A candidate the repository invokes ITSELF could not be executed and does not participate in the declared re-entrancy protocol, so whether it writes tracked content is unknown. Producer completeness may not be asserted over an executable the repository runs but cannot measure: an unprobed candidate is an undetermined verdict, and treating it as innocent would make the whole measurement fail open. A candidate that aborts BECAUSE the declared guard is armed is self-excluded, and one that nothing invokes and that cannot start unaided is unreachable; both are accounted for separately.

cycle_classes.name: Write-scope trespass
cycle_classes.remediation: Stop the trespassing stage writing outside its own zone, or move the path into the zone of the stage that actually produces it. One artifact, one producer.
cycle_classes.signature: A declared stage wrote a path that a DIFFERENT declared stage's write zone owns. Attributing the residue to some declared zone is not enough: if the writer is not the owner, the artifact has two producers and belongs to no single write scope, so regenerating it from its declared owner cannot reproduce it.

principle.rationale: Certification asserts a property of the repository. An assertion that re-execution does not reproduce is not evidence.
principle.rule: No programme may close, and no repository may be certified, unless the repository is a Stable Repository State: executing the declared pipeline over the committed HEAD leaves the repository byte-identical, for each of the declared convergence passes.
principle.title: Fixed-Point Closure Condition

principle.rationale: The commit's identity is a function of the tracked bytes it contains. An artifact that names its own commit demands a commit whose hash appears inside its own tree, which is not reachable. Committing changes HEAD, which changes the artifact, without limit. Version control already records the containing commit, so restating it inside the artifact also duplicates state the repository already owns.
principle.rule: No tracked artifact's bytes may depend on the identity of the commit that contains it — its hash, abbreviation, committer date, author date, tag or ref.
principle.title: No Commit Self-Reference

principle.rationale: Writing an unscoped observation falsifies it: an artifact recording 'working tree CLEAN, 0 entries' makes the tree dirty by being written, so the recorded value is never the value that holds once it is recorded. The defect is not the measurement, it is the self-inclusion of the recorder in what it measures. Scoping the observation to exclude the recorder's own write zone removes the self-inclusion and makes the record stable, which is why a repository-cleanliness gate may persist a verdict measured outside its own zone.
principle.rule: No tracked artifact's bytes may record an observation of the working tree that the act of recording invalidates. An observation whose scope EXCLUDES the recorder's own declared write zone does not invalidate itself and is therefore permitted; an unscoped observation is not. In every case the observation is a legitimate input to a GATE VERDICT and legitimate content of a gate's exit code and standard output.
principle.title: No Working-Tree Self-Observation

principle.rationale: This is the CK-REG-DRIFT topology exactly: the registry recorded the hash of an artifact that embedded the hash of the registry. Mutual hash embedding admits no simultaneous solution.
principle.rule: No tracked artifact may embed a content hash of any artifact that depends, directly or transitively, upon it.
principle.title: No Hash Cycle

principle.rationale: Registration records a content hash. A class whose content is derived cannot hold a stable hash relative to the register that records it. This restates GOV-005 §5.3 as a closure obligation and is the rule whose absence produced CK-REG-DRIFT.
principle.rule: Only artifacts of class CANONICAL-SOURCE are eligible for registration. Every other class is a non-artifact, excluded by a declared authority, and may never consume a permanent corpus identity.
principle.title: Registration Admits Canonical Source Only

principle.rationale: A fixed point can only be asserted over a known pipeline. Undeclared regeneration is precisely how the CK-REG-DRIFT split reached four sealed commits unnoticed. Discovery closes the residual hole in the original enforcement: attributing residue can only convict a producer that RAN inside the declared pipeline, so a producer omitted from the pipeline never ran and was never observed. Measuring the Execution Surface instead makes omission itself the detectable event.
principle.rule: Every producer that writes tracked repository content must appear as a stage of the declared pipeline. A producer absent from the pipeline is unverifiable and its output is therefore not an Acceptable Repository State. Completeness of the pipeline is itself a measured property: the repository DISCOVERS its own producers from its Execution Surface and proves, by execution, that each one is declared. Declaration is never satisfied by a list somebody remembered to update.
principle.title: Producers Are Declared, Never Discovered Ad Hoc

principle.rationale: A rule a programme must opt into is a rule the next programme forgets. Evaluating the condition over the repository rather than over a programme register makes exemption impossible and enrolment unnecessary.
principle.rule: RFP-1..RFP-6 bind every PROGRAM, EPIC, EIP, Universe, Framework, Capability and Module, present and future, with no opt-out and no per-programme exemption. Inheritance is structural: the condition is evaluated over the REPOSITORY, so anything the repository contains is bound without needing to declare itself bound.
principle.title: Universal Inheritance, No Opt-Out

programme.$excluded_location_comment: The engine RESOLVES excluded locations from these two authorities at run time (git's own ignore machinery plus the corpus-internal prefix list). It keeps no second list, so an exclusion declared once is honoured everywhere and no path is restated here.
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme legislates the closure CONDITION; it ratifies nothing, freezes nothing and owns no capability.
programme.name: Repository Fixed-Point Closure
programme.origin: CK-REG-DRIFT. A generated artifact carrying repository-derived state (HEAD, commit metadata, projection hashes) was admitted into the registration corpus, creating a registration relation with no fixed point. This declaration makes that class of topology constitutionally impossible rather than individually repaired.

vocabulary.definition: A committed repository state R is a Repository Fixed Point of the declared pipeline P when P(R) = R byte-for-byte. Executing every declared producer over R rewrites no tracked byte and creates no untracked entry outside a constitutionally excluded location.
A repository in which every producer's output is a pure function of tracked repository content. Two executions over the same tracked content, in any environment, yield identical bytes.

A state that is a Repository Fixed Point under N consecutive pipeline executions, N being the declared convergence_passes. Stability is an observation over repetitions; a fixed point observed once may be coincidence.

The state in which a programme is permitted to declare itself closed: its implementation is complete, every gate binding it PASSES, and the repository containing it is a Stable Repository State. Closure is a property of the REPOSITORY, never a property of the programme's own report.
A state that is either a Repository Fixed Point, or one whose only divergence is a declared, dispositioned finding carried in this declaration. Any other divergence is unacceptable and fails closed.

A repository for which no reachable state is a Repository Fixed Point, because at least one tracked artifact's required bytes are a function of the very act of committing or recording them. Non-convergence is a topological property: it cannot be cleared by regenerating, committing or reordering.

A repository containing at least one tracked artifact whose content depends, directly or transitively, on itself — on the identity of the commit that contains it, on an observation of the working tree that contains it, or on the hash of an artifact that depends on it. Every self-referential repository is non-convergent.
The genus. Any divergence between the committed repository and the result of re-executing the declared pipeline over it. Registration, Projection and Evidence Drift are its species.

Divergence between the registered corpus and the artifacts on disk: an artifact's recorded identity, content hash or classification no longer matches the artifact. Owned and detected by REG-AUTO-001 (register.sh --guard / CK-REG-DRIFT).
Divergence between a derived projection and the canonical source it projects: the projection was not regenerated after its source changed, or was regenerated from a stale reading of it.

Divergence between recorded evidence and the state it claims to evidence: a verdict, measurement or certification asserting a repository state that re-execution does not reproduce. An evidence artifact that records an observation invalidated by its own writing is permanently in Evidence Drift.

An executable the repository itself can invoke that writes tracked repository content. Both halves are measured, never assumed: invocability is read from the repository's own Execution Surface, and writing is OBSERVED by executing the candidate and comparing tracked content. Neither half appeals to a filename, a directory, a naming convention or a list, so the definition admits producers that do not exist yet.

The set of invocations the repository declares it performs: the recipe lines of its build entry point and the steps of its continuous-integration workflows, plus the argv of every declared pipeline stage. It is the repository's own statement of what it executes, maintained for its own reasons, and is therefore a discovery authority that cannot fall out of date without the repository ceasing to build.

A repository in which every Producer discovered from the Execution Surface is a declared pipeline stage, every path any Producer writes lies inside exactly one declared write zone, and no discovered candidate remains unprobed. Producer completeness is thus a MEASUREMENT over the repository rather than a list somebody maintains, and it is re-measured on every gate run.
